title: Joint faithfulness of finite quotient evaluations after integral reduction
statement:
theorem integralSystemReduction_map_ext
    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    {A B : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X}
    (p q : A ⟶ B)
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (finiteSystemDerivedEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
          (integralSystemTransition l E) X n).map
          ((integralSystemReduction l E X).map p) =
        (finiteSystemDerivedEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
          (integralSystemTransition l E) X n).map
          ((integralSystemReduction l E X).map q)) :
    (integralSystemReduction l E X).map p =
      (integralSystemReduction l E X).map q

source.place: the levelwise extensionality step for the coherent coefficient-system reduction.

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the proposed componentwise-localization argument confuses joint conservativity on objects with joint faithfulness on morphisms. For a complete target the kernel of the map to the inverse limit of finite Hom groups is lim^1 Hom(A[1], B_n), by the Milnor exact sequence. This kernel can be nonzero on Spec Q; the Q1 report constructs an explicit nonzero Roos cokernel class from cyclotomic characters ramified at distinct primes. No proof of the unrestricted assertion is claimed. A separate, proved finite shifted-Hom criterion is recorded in lem-pur-integral-system-reduction-map-ext-finite; it does not discharge this node without its additional hypothesis.
